design: All10 frozen H852 preMLP4 fits, plus global/residual PCA48/64, on all78 H849 pairs both directions. Model selection used only natural-text developmentMSE. Task activations/directions used only now for evaluation.
intervention: Native recipient normalizedshape + decoded donor-minus-recipient residual; renormalize and restore native recipient rawRMS. Preserve recipient reconstructionerror, mean cancels at same relaytoken. Compare exact donor shape/recipient radius and full rawdonor.
metrics: Full task-effect fidelity to exactshape and rawdonor, output KL(shape-reference||model), contrastgeometry and postfit decoder-direction overlap. Overlap alone is not recovery; no best-feature cherry-picking for causal swaps.
scope: H849 reused tasks, not a fresh confirmation after architecture training. Training and hyperparameters taskblind but research design task-informed. No reserved-test.
